purpose: Machine-readable pre-registered case schedule for the authorization-gated preview resource probe plan. Every future authorized probe operation, invocation, ATTEMPTED QUERY, statement, bind payload, row read/write and storage bound is derived from THIS file. The LOCAL-only feasibility validator (audit-tools/probe-plan/validate-probe-plan.mjs) proves: bind counts, required schemas, reachable gates, invocation/repetition totals, reconciled payload/read/write/storage bounds, same-link fixture round-trips, and behavioral latch controls. The validator's replay is a STRUCTURAL SIMULATION (SELECT-1/simplified substitutes), NOT a full semantic/resource replay; the full-poll-equivalent harness is UNPROVEN (proofScope). Nothing in this schedule has been executed; publication is HELD (publicationSafety).

accounting.bindByteDefinition: UTF-8 bytes via TextEncoder for strings; 8 bytes conservative for numeric/NULL binds (the audited internal definition, mirrored from design-lab/candidate-sql.ts bindBytes)
accounting.attemptedQueryDefinition: D1 CONTRACT (R1141-02, pinned by the permanent workerd control audit-tools/d1-contract/): prepare() is CONSTRUCTION ONLY and never a submitted statement; TERMINAL execution (.all()/.first()/.run()/db.batch) is the attempted query and is counted in apiCalls/statements EVEN WHEN REJECTED. node:sqlite COMPILES at prepare(), so a local compile rejection is LOCAL-ENGINE metadata (proves the column truly does not exist) and is NEVER a Cloudflare billable counter.
accounting.engineMetadataDistinction: Local validator numbers (statements attempted, local changes, measured SQLite bytes) are LOCAL-ENGINE feasibility proxies. Cloudflare billable counters (rows_read/rows_written per-query meta, owner-side daily analytics, Workers requests) are separate surfaces measured only during authorized execution rounds (P-08).

reservedRefusalAndEmergencyOverhead.note: R1141-04: RESERVED bounded allowance (may be unused) for authorized-but-rejected latch observations (duplicate deliveries, kill-switch observation/activation, closed/exhausted cases) and the emergency hard-stop batch (set __global__ aborted + close the case). Detecting any refusal costs exactly ONE submitted UPDATE with zero durable changes; these attempts are counted D1 attempts. Beyond this reserve, ANY additional refused attempt is an abort-criterion event (registered outcome set exceeded).
